name: Solaarchy
author: C50NK4
description: Every connected Logitech device at a glance in the Omarchy bar: battery per device, live connect and disconnect, low-battery alerts and the keyboard backlight, read through Solaar. Add-ons extend each device's drawer; the built-in Circadian lights the keyboard from dusk to dawn.

barWidget.description: Battery and backlight for your Logitech devices at a glance, via Solaar. Left-click: panel. Right-click: keyboard backlight. Middle-click: open Solaar.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: solaar, or a device icon: auto (follows your devices), mouse, keyboard, combo, each also as -outline. To use your own artwork instead, see customIcon.

schema.label: Custom bar icon
schema.description: File name of an SVG in the custom icon folder, without the .svg (for example: my-logo). Overrides the bar icon above while set. Solaarchy ships no vendor logos, so this is how you use your own.

schema.label: Custom icon folder
schema.description: Folder scanned for custom bar icons. Defaults to ~/.config/omarchy/solaarchy/icons.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Backup poll. Connects, disconnects and receiver plugging update right away; each poll wakes the receiver, so keep this relaxed.

schema.label: Low battery threshold (%)
schema.description: Below this the icon turns urgent and one notification is sent per discharge.

schema.label: Low battery notification
schema.description: Notify once per discharge when a device drops below the low battery threshold.

schema.label: Critical battery notification
schema.description: One more, urgent notification when a device drops to 5%.

schema.label: Connected and disconnected notifications
schema.description: Notify when a device has had no link for 5 minutes, and when it comes back. Asleep and switched off look the same, hence the wait.

schema.label: Hide when no receiver
schema.description: Hide the widget while no Logitech receiver is plugged in, no Logitech device is connected by cable or Bluetooth, and none is paired over Bluetooth. It reappears when one is plugged in or paired.

schema.label: Circadian
schema.description: Built-in add-on: turn every backlit keyboard's light on at civil dusk and off at civil dawn. Switching it by hand in between holds until the next dusk or dawn. A keyboard's drawer in the panel can skip it.

schema.label: Circadian timing (minutes)
schema.description: Moves both switches: 30 turns the light on 30 minutes before dusk and off 30 minutes after dawn. Negative: later on, earlier off.

schema.label: Circadian location
schema.description: Latitude and longitude, for example 48.21, 16.37 (south and west negative). Empty uses Omarchy's weather location (omarchy-weather-location --set), else your timezone's city.

schema.label: Rainbow LED (experimental)
schema.description: Built-in experimental add-on: a greyed mock-up of a colour control in each lit device's drawer. It changes nothing.
